scope.purpose: Freeze exactly one definition-mature historical experiment after P1-EXP-001 stopped as data-blocked.
allowed: future historical underlying-only evaluation under the frozen design
forbidden_in_this_issue: option-premium, PnL, win-rate, or EV calculation

source_catalog.role: Binds the immutable P1-EXP-001 design that this revision does not edit or reinterpret.
Binds the P1-EXP-001 registry and canonical-design anchors.
Freezes the six-family order, roles, audit surface, and prohibition on ranking.
Establishes broad underlying interface presence and the option, IV, freshness, and observability limitations.
Binds the public-safe aggregate underlying coverage and quality evidence for all six families.
Defines SR-01 and records SR-02 as unavailable for reuse and SR-03 as too subjective.
Binds future-row invariance, public-safety, deterministic regeneration, and outcome-free exploration constraints.
Establishes six-family descriptive coverage without selecting or ranking a family.
Supplies the causal roll, aggregation, exact-close, breakout, and EMA conventions reused by SR-01.
Binds the empty M6-EXP-013 candidate set and protects it from relabeling or retuning.

prior_registry_decision.reason: Zero frozen-universe families satisfied the causal option and IV capability gate.
prior_registry_decision.carry_forward: P1-EXP-001 remains immutable and is not pooled with, relabeled as, or used as a tuning surface for P1-EXP-002.

candidate_decisions.reason: It is the only candidate with a complete causal event definition and it can be tested using underlying inputs without option or IV synthesis.
Its directional mapping belongs to the frozen negative M6-EXP-013 family.
B boundaries, DD-line anchors, tolerances, confirmation, and invalidation remain discretionary.

selected_experiment.statement: Across the fixed six-family universe, a completed daily strict-prior-20 breakout whose direction agrees with causal EMA5 versus EMA20 alignment on D, W, 60-minute, and 15-minute views has positive five-completed-daily-bar signal-signed underlying close return.
selection_reasoning_fixed_pre_outcome: The candidate-interface audit establishes underlying OHLCV/OI presence at every required cadence for all six predeclared families.
No family is selected or excluded using excursion, activity, option-path change, overlay availability, or outcome performance.
The selected lane does not require stale or quality-invalid option overlays, exact option expiry, delta, bid/ask, or causal IV history.
The event clauses reuse committed causal roll and aggregation conventions and leave no chart interpretation to the implementer.
One fixed five-session horizon represents one exchange week and is not searched or combined with another horizon.

causal_roll_policy.active_contract_eligibility: A contract is eligible on a session only when its prior-session row exists, is causally available before the session decision, has finite nonnegative open_interest and volume, and passes timestamp, duplicate, and OHLC coherence checks.
causal_roll_policy.candidate_enumeration: Enumerate exactly the frozen family contract universe observed in the causally filtered prior-session snapshot; never infer candidates from posterior rows or embedded calendar annotations.
causal_roll_policy.prior_session_requirements: Require one and only one causally filtered prior-session row per candidate contract with finite nonnegative volume and finite open_interest; missing, duplicate, nonfinite, or incoherent rows make that candidate ineligible.
causal_roll_policy.zero_and_missing_handling: Zero or missing open_interest makes a contract ineligible for OI leadership; zero or missing volume makes it ineligible for volume leadership. If no eligible leader remains, preserve the incumbent only when its own causal row remains valid; otherwise emit no selected contract and abstain.
causal_roll_policy.leader_rule: If every active candidate has strictly positive open_interest, choose the maximum prior-session open_interest; otherwise choose the maximum prior-session volume among candidates with strictly positive finite volume.
causal_roll_policy.tie_rule: Resolve equal leadership values by bytewise ascending contract identifier.
causal_roll_policy.confirmation_rule: The proposed leader must win on three consecutive exchange trading sessions; a missing session, ineligible proposed leader, or different leader resets the streak to zero.
causal_roll_policy.streak_reset: Reset confirmation to zero whenever the proposed leader changes, any required prior-session row is invalid, or the exchange session is absent from the bound calendar.
causal_roll_policy.incumbent_expiry: An incumbent expires immediately when its next causal prior-session row is missing, invalid, or outside the frozen candidate universe; no forced roll or posterior repair is permitted.
causal_roll_policy.initial_state: no incumbent contract at history_start_inclusive; the first selection becomes effective only on the session after one leader satisfies all three confirmation sessions

history_initialization.indicator_history_membership: For every frozen-family contract and required level, use all causally valid contract-local completed bars at or after history_start_inclusive, regardless of whether that contract is selected at the bar timestamp; never splice bars from different contracts into one indicator series.
history_initialization.roll_away_behavior: Retain each contract's causal D/W/60min/15min indicator state while it is not selected; do not update it with another contract's bars.
history_initialization.roll_back_behavior: When a contract becomes selected again, resume its retained contract-local state through the current completed bar; no reset or reuse of another contract's state is permitted.
history_initialization.ema_rule: For each selected contract and level independently, initialize EMA5 and EMA20 to the first finite completed close at or after history_start_inclusive, then apply adjust=false recurrences alpha=2/(span+1) in completed-bar order.

decision_event.decision_cadence: every exchange trading date in the active staged window
decision_event.source_timestamp_cutoff: timestamp <= decision timestamp before session mapping or aggregation
decision_event.daily_aggregation: OHLCV/OI over exchange trading date; timestamp is final included period end
decision_event.weekly_aggregation: OHLCV/OI over ISO year/week of causal D bars, including the decision-time partial week
decision_event.hourly_aggregation: OHLCV/OI over consecutive 60-minute trading-session offsets anchored at night-session open
decision_event.min15_aggregation: OHLCV/OI over consecutive 15-minute trading-session offsets anchored at night-session open
decision_event.prior_20_high: maximum high of the 20 completed D bars strictly before the current D bar
decision_event.prior_20_low: minimum low of the 20 completed D bars strictly before the current D bar
decision_event.ema_5: causal close EWM with span 5 and adjust=false through the current completed bar
decision_event.ema_20: causal close EWM with span 20 and adjust=false through the current completed bar
decision_event.up_event: D close > strict-prior-20 D high and EMA5 > EMA20 on D, W, 60min, and 15min
decision_event.down_event: D close < strict-prior-20 D low and EMA5 < EMA20 on D, W, 60min, and 15min
decision_event.duplicate_rule: Retain one event only when every copy has identical filtered-input binding and causal fields; otherwise exclude every copy of the key.
abstain_conditions: fewer than 20 completed prior bars on any required level
missing or nonfinite OHLCV/OI input used by roll, aggregation, breakout, or EMA
OHLC coherence violation in any used row
causal roll ambiguity or unavailable prior-session selection fields
more than one event direction or disagreement on any required EMA alignment
filtered input, acquisition version, calendar, session, or roll-ledger binding unavailable

causal_inputs.name: exact causally filtered futures input snapshot
causal_inputs.required_binding: content SHA-256 or immutable acquisition-version identifier plus filtered-row digest

causal_inputs.name: contract-local futures OHLCV/OI with source timestamps
causal roll ledger and exchange session calendar

pre_outcome_materialization.field_projection: Read only source identity, timestamps, OHLCV/OI, calendar, session, and causal roll fields needed by event construction; forward closes are inaccessible to this pass.
pre_outcome_materialization.all_stage_membership_rule: Materialize and hash the causal event, abstain, conflict, decision-time exclusion, family, direction, selected-contract, and decision-date fields for all three stages before reading or joining any forward close. P1-EXP-002-EX-03 is not a causal-membership exclusion and is applied only after its stage unlocks.
pre_outcome_materialization.outcome_join_rule: After the all-stage membership manifest is immutable, the outcome loader may join only the sealed event keys for the currently unlocked stage. It records P1-EXP-002-EX-03 outcome availability without changing causal event membership, then computes values only for the remaining effective events.
pre_outcome_materialization.chronology_anchor_requirement: Use the protected merged Git commit containing the exact registry and lock as the external anchor. The first-access attestation must record that commit, prove it is an ancestor of the builder source commit, and predate all event materialization and forward-outcome reads.

exclusions.rule: Exclude every event that meets an abstain condition; do not proxy, fill, switch family, or relax a clause.
Exclude a conflicted duplicate key in every copy before reading forward closes.
exclusions.reason: One causal contract-local event contributes at most one observation.

exclusions.rule: Exclude an event without a finite strictly positive decision close and fifth subsequent completed daily close for the same contract by the stage cutoff; do not roll, shorten, fill, or substitute the outcome horizon.
exclusions.reason: The outcome contract and horizon are fixed at the event.
exclusions.attrition_gate: Apply the predeclared stage and family-direction EX-03 attrition limits before estimating; excess attrition is insufficient_sample.

exclusions.rule: Exclude any row failing timestamp, duplicate, finite-value, or OHLC-coherence checks before event construction.
exclusions.reason: Current-vintage historical data remains usable only under explicit quality gates.

exclusions.rule: Do not read or join option premiums, expiry, delta, IV, bid/ask, strategy decisions, PnL, or execution fields.
exclusions.reason: This is an underlying-only definition test and unavailable inputs may not be synthesized.

outcome.name: five_completed_daily_bar_signal_signed_underlying_close_return
outcome.formula: direction_multiplier * (same_contract_close_on_5th_subsequent_completed_daily_bar / decision_close - 1), where up=+1 and down=-1
outcome.availability_rule: The estimand is conditional on same-contract fifth-close availability. Admit an effective observation only when the decision close and fifth subsequent completed daily close are finite and strictly positive; otherwise apply EX-03.
outcome.outcome_access_boundary: Only the separate event-keyed same-contract T+5 availability/value join may read later rows, after causal membership is sealed; later decision construction may read only rows timestamp-truncated to that later decision.

sample_gate.effective_event_definition: A sealed causal event that remains after the current unlocked stage applies P1-EXP-002-EX-03 without changing causal membership.
sample_gate.ex03_attrition_measure: For each stage and family-direction cell, EX-03 attrition is unavailable-T+5 events divided by all causal event-membership rows in that cell; if either maximum is exceeded, classify the stage as insufficient_sample.

primary_estimand.name: equal_family_equal_direction_mean_signal_signed_return
primary_estimand.within_cell: arithmetic mean by instrument_family and event direction
primary_estimand.within_family: equal 0.5 weight to up and down cell means
primary_estimand.across_families: arithmetic mean of the six fixed-weight family means

bootstrap.date_bin: All admitted events sharing an exchange trading date move together.
bootstrap.calendar: Sorted union of exchange trading dates in the current staged window, including dates with zero admitted events.
bootstrap.block_start_rule: Sample start indices uniformly with replacement and wrap only within the current staged window.
bootstrap.sample_length_rule: Concatenate blocks to the original calendar length and truncate excess dates.
bootstrap.invalid_replicate_rule: Discard a replicate when any fixed family-direction cell is empty; replace until 2000 valid replicates or 20000 attempts.

prng.state_transition: state=(state+0x9E3779B97F4A7C15) mod 2^64; z=state; z=((z xor (z>>30))*0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9) mod 2^64; z=((z xor (z>>27))*0x94D049BB133111EB) mod 2^64; output=z xor (z>>31)
prng.uniform_index_mapping: For N possible block starts, limit=floor(2^64/N)*N; reject outputs >= limit; accepted index=output mod N.
prng.stream_rule: Use one continuous stream for the stage. Every attempted block start and every discarded replicate consumes draws; never reset between replicates or attempts.

bootstrap.interval: two-sided percentile interval with linear interpolation at p*(n-1) for p=0.025 and p=0.975

sequential_evaluation.advance_rule: Advance without adaptation only when the current sample gate passes, 2000 valid replicates exist, and the interval lower bound is strictly greater than zero.
sequential_evaluation.falsified_rule: Stop as falsified when the current sample gate passes, 2000 valid replicates exist, and the interval upper bound is less than or equal to zero.
sequential_evaluation.inconclusive_rule: Stop as inconclusive when the sample or valid-replicate gate fails or the interval lower bound is less than or equal to zero and its upper bound is greater than zero.
sequential_evaluation.holdout_rule: Evaluate the holdout exactly once only after immutable training and validation manifests both record advancement.

classification.supported: Training and validation advance without adaptation and the single-use holdout passes its gates with interval lower bound strictly greater than zero.
classification.falsified: The first evaluated stage with passing sample and replicate gates has interval upper bound less than or equal to zero.
classification.inconclusive: The first evaluated stage fails a sample or replicate gate or has interval lower bound less than or equal to zero and upper bound greater than zero.

secondary_diagnostics: event, abstain, exclusion, and conflict counts by family, direction, stage, and reason
fixed family-direction cell means and intervals
coverage by decision date and selected contract
future-row invariance and filtered-input binding audit

required_properties: reviewed and merged historical-replay allow or deny surface
exact filtered-input content hash or immutable acquisition version plus filtered-row digest
unavailable bid/ask, delta, expiry, and IV recorded without synthesis

prohibited_adaptations: add, drop, reorder, rank, or reweight a family
change the causal roll rule, confirmation count, tie rule, or effective session
change history start, roll initialization, EMA initialization, or warmup
change the 15:00 decision close, source cutoff, session mapping, or aggregation rules
change strict-prior-20 breakout or EMA5 versus EMA20 agreement on any level
change abstain, duplicate, exclusion, or OHLC-quality handling
change the five-completed-daily-bar horizon or selected outcome contract
change staged-window dates, roles, gates, or single-use holdout rule
change family-direction weights, bootstrap, seed, interval, or classification
change the PRNG, index mapping, stream consumption, or golden vector
pool stages, inspect sealed outcomes, repeat holdout, or adapt between stages
materialize or recompute any stage membership after forward-outcome access
select a subgroup or family as the primary result
join or synthesize option, IV, bid/ask, delta, PnL, or execution fields
reuse or reinterpret SR-02, SR-03, M6-EXP-013, or P1-EXP-001
replace an exact filtered-input binding with an anonymous membership hash

material_distinction_from_p1_exp_001: P1-EXP-001 is an AU/AG prospective option-IV rank experiment; P1-EXP-002 is a six-family historical underlying-only structural test.
P1-EXP-001 requires selected option legs, exact expiry, causal IV history, and a 17-bar option-premium outcome; P1-EXP-002 forbids those inputs and uses one five-bar same-contract underlying outcome.
P1-EXP-001 stopped as data-blocked and remains immutable; P1-EXP-002 receives a new registry version, experiment id, design hash, and freeze lock.
material_distinction_from_m6_exp_013: M6-EXP-013 used causal swing-line labels and a six-label direction mapping; P1-EXP-002 uses no swing-line label and requires daily breakout plus four-view EMA agreement.
M6-EXP-013 screened 1, 3, and 5-bar horizons on a fixed AU/AG corpus; P1-EXP-002 freezes one five-bar horizon before materialization across all six audited families.
The M6-EXP-013 empty candidate set remains rejected and cannot be rescued by P1-EXP-002.

amendment_policy.correction_before_any_event_materializat: Create registry v3 and P1-EXP-003; do not edit v2 in place.
amendment_policy.change_after_any_event_or_outcome_access: Invalidate P1-EXP-002 and register a new experiment id under a new registry version.
amendment_policy.result_binding: Every stage manifest must bind the exact v2 registry SHA-256, canonical design SHA-256, protected merged registry commit, first-access chronology attestation, approved data-gate SHA-256, filtered-input digest, source commit, arguments, stage id, and output hashes.
